description: Two windowed comparators, each gating on whether its input is above, within or below a voltage window, with those gates combined by logic and flip flops

params.text: Sets the centre of that comparator's window, -10V to 10V, summed with its SHIFT CV input
Sets the width of that comparator's window, 0V to 10V, summed with its SIZE CV input; the window runs half that width either side of the shift
Sets the low and high voltages for every gate output: 0-1V, 0-5V, 0-10V, or the bipolar 1V, 5V and 10V pairs
Sets oversampling to off, 2x, 4x, 8x, 16x or 32x, cutting the aliasing that high frequency audio inputs introduce

inputs.text: Shifts the centre of the first window, added to the SHIFT1 knob a volt for a volt
Widens the first window, added to the SIZE1 knob a volt for a volt
Widens the second window, added to the SIZE2 knob a volt for a volt; unpatched it takes the SIZE1 CV input
Shifts the centre of the second window, added to the SHIFT2 knob a volt for a volt; unpatched it takes the SHIFT1 CV input
The voltage the first comparator tests against its window
The voltage the second comparator tests against its window; unpatched it takes the IN1 input

outputs.text: High while that comparator's input is above the top of its window
High while that comparator's input is not above the top of its window
High while that comparator's input is inside its window
High while that comparator's input is outside its window
High while that comparator's input is below the bottom of its window
High while that comparator's input is not below the bottom of its window
High while both inputs are above their windows
High while either input is above its window
High while one input is above its window and the other is not
Changes state on each leading edge of the XOR greater gate
High while both inputs are inside their windows
High while either input is inside its window
High while one input is inside its window and the other is not
Changes state on each leading edge of the XOR equal gate
High while both inputs are below their windows
High while either input is below its window
High while one input is below its window and the other is not
Changes state on each leading edge of the XOR less gate

notes: an effective window size below 0V puts the window maximum under its minimum, and the equality output can then never go high
menu: Monitor channel — what the LEDs at the gate outputs show: Off, All for polyphonic channels as proportional brightness, or 1 to 16 to follow one channel
Oversample filter quality — 10th order by default, with 8th order and a cheaper 6th order; 10th and 8th cut at 80% of Nyquist and 6th at 50%
